summary: Tested the fix for the slow About paragraphs. ALL PASSED. Backend (5/5 pytest): cached GET /api/content and /api/assets take about 0.09-0.13s through the proxy (cold after the 60s TTL: 0.68s). Content PUT, POST and DELETE invalidate the cache immediately, and asset PUT alt shows up on the next GET right away; every value was restored. Frontend: a rAF observer measured when the [data-testid=about-body] / about-body-mobile paragraphs appear (ms from navigation start). Desktop 1920x800: first visit with localStorage cleared 894ms, refreshes 1197 / 801ms. Mobile 390x844: first visit 960ms, refreshes 855 / 1034ms. The old default text 'Our approach' NEVER appeared. 'Our strength...' (CMS text) was there in the very first paint every time. CMS UI: changed about.title to orig+' X' and blurred; public /about showed the new title, so the cache was invalidated. Restored through the UI; an API diff against the snapshot shows 0 diffs and 0 new keys. The CMS 'Tampilan asli' live iframe for About showed the paragraphs (CMS text, no default) about 0.95s after the iframe mounted. Regression: Home, Subsidiaries, Pillars and About all render CMS values; no page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: sb_select cache: _cache_clear runs BEFORE the write. A concurrent public GET during the Supabase write can re-fill the cache with pre-write rows, which then stay stale for up to 60s. Also clear the cache after the write succeeds (in a finally block) in sb_insert/sb_update/sb_delete and in the asset upsert.
The cache is per-process. That is fine with --workers 1, but invalidation will not reach other workers or replicas if production scales out (60s staleness at most).

LanguageContext stale-while-revalidate: a returning visitor sees cached (possibly old) CMS text first and it swaps when /api/content returns. This is acceptable, but there is no expiry or version on 'sunjaya_content_v1'.
If /api/content fails on first load, contentReady becomes true and the bundled default paragraphs show. That is the intended fallback.
seed_data_creation: None. Snapshot /tmp/content_orig_16.json. The temporary TEST_cache.key block was deleted, and about.title and the asset alt were restored (verified).
